editorial.blurb: Guinness Open Gate Brewery brings the iconic Irish stout to Chicago with a polished taproom space, knowledgeable Guinness pours, and approachable comfort food that hits the mark for beer lovers.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the potato & leek soup with brown bread—it's a standout—and give the Stout in Office a few minutes to let the flavors develop; brunch service tends to be less busy if you're looking for a relaxed visit.
signatureDishes: Potato & leek soup with brown bread
